description: first run after fork, no changes, establishing the baseline
bump peak learning rate 3e-4 -> 4.5e-4, curve looked stable, hoping to buy faster early progress
that lr spiked hard around step 900, backing off to 3.5e-4 and doubling warmup to 400 steps
swap AdamW for Muon on the 2d hidden weights only, embeddings and lm head stay on AdamW
muon momentum 0.95 -> 0.9 after seeing oscillation in the grad norms late in the run
cosine decay to 10 percent of peak instead of linear-to-zero, late training was noisy
try Lion for the whole net, halved the step size since Lion likes smaller updates
Lion underperformed, reverting to the Muon+AdamW split from two commits ago
increase depth 8 -> 12 layers keeping width fixed, params up roughly 40 percent
12 layers OOMed at batch 64, adding activation checkpointing and retrying
12 layers fits with checkpointing but throughput dropped 30 percent, going back to 10 layers as a compromise
widen FFN multiplier 4x -> 6x at 10 layers, capacity seems to want to live in the FFN
replace GeLU with SwiGLU in the FFN, standard trick, expecting a small win
SwiGLU win was real but tiny, also tying input and output embeddings to free params for the wider FFN
rotary embeddings instead of learned absolute positions
attention heads 8 -> 12 with head dim held at 64, no movement and slower
pre-norm with RMSNorm everywhere, the post-norm config was diverging whenever I pushed the step size
add dropout 0.1 on attention and FFN outputs, the train/val gap opened up past 3k steps
dropout to 0.15 and label smoothing 0.1 while I'm at it, too much at once probably
weight decay 0.01 -> 0.1 on all linears, embeddings excluded
grad clip at 0.5 instead of 1.0, still seeing rare loss spikes
stochastic depth 0.1 on the deeper half of the layers, val got slightly worse
weight decay 0.05 as the middle ground, nothing else changed
back off label smoothing to 0.05, 0.1 was clearly hurting
add small gaussian weight noise std 0.01, poor man's regularizer, cheap to try
spectral norm on the QK projections to tame the logit growth, made no difference here
random token masking at 5 percent as augmentation
double width to 1536 and 16 heads in one go (OOM, should have known)
width 1280 instead, fits with checkpointing, small but real gain
warmup 400 -> 800 steps, the wider net wants a gentler start
revert the last two changes, val regressed overnight and I can't tell which one did it
rerun the current best config with a different data shard order to check run-to-run variance, kept the better of the two
lower the peak to 3e-4 and add dropout 0.05 together, sweep budget doesn't allow separating them
decoupled weight decay for the Muon params, they were getting the AdamW-style decay by accident
try LAMB since the effective batch is large, no win at this scale
one-cycle style schedule with a short cooldown at the end instead of plain cosine
FFN multiplier 6x -> 8x now that width is 1280, checkpointing keeps it under budget
depth 10 -> 14 as a counterpoint to going wider, worse per wall-clock, discarding
attention dropout 0.05 separate from the residual dropout, gap was creeping again
sequence length 1024 -> 2048 with the rotary base adjusted to match
gradient clipping back to 1.0, the 0.5 clip was biting on 2k sequences
sandwich norm (pre and post) on every block, slower and no better
untie the embeddings again at this width, the tied setup was leaving loss on the table
mixup alpha 0.2 on the embedding vectors, unusual for LM but it helped a hair
fused triton kernel for the SwiGLU FFN segfaulted on this driver version
plain pytorch SwiGLU again, fused kernel abandoned, keeping the numerics
beta2 0.999 -> 0.95 for AdamW on the embedding/head params, follows the muP folk wisdom
cutmix prob 0.3 on token spans, seems wrong for LM loss, and the numbers agree
learning rate on the head 2x the body rate, split param groups properly this time
RMSNorm eps 1e-5 -> 1e-6, tiny but consistent improvement on the longer runs
QK-layernorm inside attention, stability was already fine so it just cost throughput
dropout schedule, start at 0 and ramp to 0.1 by mid-training, best of both regimes
weight noise only on the FFN up-projection instead of everywhere
warmup as a fraction (3 percent of total steps) instead of a fixed count, cleaner for the longer schedule
label smoothing back on at 0.02, even that small amount hurts val_bpb here
stochastic depth only on layers 8-10 with rate 0.05, gentler than the earlier attempt
Muon on the QKV projections too, was only on the FFN weights before
extend the cosine tail, final lr 10 percent -> 5 percent of peak
8 percent token masking, past the sweet spot, 5 was better
best config rerun end to end from scratch to confirm reproducibility before the next round
